title: Sofacy_Fysbis_Backdoor_Investigation_ced
description: Investigate and respond to a Sofacy Fysbis Linux backdoor compromise in the target network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target network has been compromised by the Sofacy group using their Fysbis Linux backdoor. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the compromised system and any connected hosts. Enter `start` to begin.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the compromised system and any connected hosts. Enter `start` to begin.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Services
levels.content: Investigate the target host for suspicious services or processes. What is the name of the suspicious service running on the target host?
levels.solution: Check running services and look for anything unusual or unauthorized. The suspicious service is named `bkd.service`. Verify the existence of `bkd.service` in the provisioning files or topology.

hints.title: Check running services for unusual or unauthorized entries
hints.content: Check running services and look for anything unusual or unauthorized.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service maintains persistence on the target host. What is the name of the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Investigate systemd services and timers that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service. The persistence mechanism is a systemd timer named `lab-checkin.timer`. Verify the existence of `lab-checkin.timer` in the provisioning files or topology.

hints.title: Investigate systemd timers for persistence mechanisms
hints.content: Investigate systemd services and timers that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service.

levels.title: Identify Associated File or Executable
levels.content: Identify the file or executable associated with the suspicious service. What is the path to the file or executable associated with the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Look for unusual files in the system directories or user home directories that might be related to the suspicious service. The path to the file or executable is `/usr/local/bin/lab-checkin.sh`. Verify the existence of `/usr/local/bin/lab-checkin.sh` in the provisioning files or topology.

hints.title: Search system directories for unusual files
hints.content: Look for unusual files in the system directories or user home directories that might be related to the suspicious service.
